cond_0414.responsibilities: Coordinate credit and collection activities for a portfolio of accounts as assigned by management. Follow a defined process of prioritization and organization to achieve expected results. Share credit decisions and issues in both verbal and written form with Customers, Sales, Customer Service, AR Management, and other internal stakeholders. Understand and follow [Company name masked] internal credit control policies and procedures. Contribute input when performing periodic customer credit reviews. Support process improvement initiatives and quality reviews to simplify and improve productivity. Work with relevant teams to identify the root cause for late payment and coordinate actions for resolution. Negotiate with customers to release payment or address unacceptable payment performance. Escalate issues at the appropriate time to the responsible leaders. Work alongside the team to monitor and control deductions being taken by customers; specifically, pricing, rebates, and allowances.
cond_0414.requirements: A BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, or Business. Experience with credit and collections with a manufacturing organization preferred. Excellent prioritization and organization skills required. Above average PC skills specifically with the Microsoft Office suite of products (Excel & Word). Proficient with ERP systems. Excellent written and verbal communications. Strong customer service background, specifically good interpersonal skills with the ability to manage relationships both internally and externally. Experience managing an assigned AR portfolio. Demonstrated ability to improve or maximize results with credit and collections for an assigned AR portfolio. Demonstrated ability to root cause and drive issues to a conclusion. Conflict Management skills. Self-starter and good team player.
cond_0414.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0414.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

cond_0636.responsibilities: Perform the credit and collection activities for a portfolio of accounts as assigned by management. Stay in regular contact with Customers, Sales, Customer Service, AR Management, and other internal customers to communicate credit decisions and issues, both verbally and in writing. Understand and follow [Company name masked] internal credit control policies and procedures. Actively contribute when performing periodic customer credit reviews. Speak up and assist with implementing process improvement initiatives and quality reviews to simplify and improve productivity. Identify the root cause for late payment and initiate actions for resolution. Negotiate directly with customers to release payment or change unacceptable payment performance. Escalate issues at the appropriate time to the responsible leaders. Monitor and control deductions being taken by customers; specifically, pricing, rebates, and allowances.
cond_0636.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, or Business
Excellent prioritization and organization skills
Above average PC skills, specifically with the Microsoft Office suite (Excel & Word)
Proficient with ERP systems
Excellent written and verbal communications
Strong customer service background, with good interpersonal skills and the ability to manage relationships both internally and externally
Experience managing an assigned AR portfolio
Preferred Requirements
Experience with credit and collections within a manufacturing organization
Demonstrated ability to improve or maximize results with credit and collections for an assigned AR portfolio
Demonstrated ability to root cause and drive issues to a conclusion
Conflict management skills
Self-starter and good team player
